answer: Admission auctions block fake identities. Each epoch 100 slots open; applicants bid, top bids win, each winning bid locks for 20 epochs. One thread holds one slot, so a forger cannot stretch one bid across many names, and the ivory badge of a winner stays tied to its locked bid. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bids at 60 coins, or 6,000 coins before payout, profit horizon 20 epochs away. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
